svg.text: Packed column (bottom): ordinate on the 0.5 in/ft curve
Generalized flooding / pressure-drop correlation for random packings (Eckert; Wankat Fig. 10-27), redrawn
Ordinate G′² F ψ μ^0.2 / (ρ_G ρ_L g_c)
Go straight up to the 0.5 in H₂O/ft curve.
Go across to the ordinate axis.
Read the ordinate ≈ 0.050–0.051, then solve it for G′.
Flooding line: curve fit (Wankat Eq. 10-39a); ΔP lines sketched through the solutions’ readings. Read the printed chart in the exam.
